title: As Anger Grows Over Trump Tariffs, Some in Canada Want Out of U.S. F-35 Deal
summary: A year into a government review of the purchase of as many as 88 F-35s, one premier says buying American warplanes makes no sense in the face of President Trump’s latest tariffs.
